title: Trace Heating & Lagging
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Heating cable inspected for damage before fixing?
Cable fixed tight along the pipe, no kinks, lagging over it undamaged?
Ask the fitter: What insulation thickness is specified for this pipe? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Lagging continuous, joints taped, no gaps or squashed sections?
Joints sealed, external cladding weathered, warning labels fitted?
Cable not crossing over itself anywhere along the pipe?
Power connection kit and end seal fitted neatly?
Thermostat/probe at the position on the trace heating drawing, under the lagging?
Access panels provided at sensor and termination locations?

notOk.t: Lagging missing or incomplete at valves
Lagging blocking access to valve sets
Vapour seal missing on chilled pipework

ask.q: Has the trace heating been tested before lagging?
ask.a: Yes – insulation resistance and continuity, recorded.

ask.q: What thickness and type is the lagging here?
ask.a: As the spec for this pipe size and location – they can say.
Yes – 'Electric trace heated' labels along the run.
